arguments.value: Thomas M. Golden (November 1, 1947 – July 31, 2010) was a federal judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, appointed by President George W. Bush in 2006 and serving until his death in 2010. Born in Pottsville, Pennsylvania, he earned his B.A. from Pennsylvania State University in 1969 and his J.D. from Dickinson School of Law in 1972. Golden spent his legal career in private practice in Pennsylvania from 1972 to 2006 before joining the federal bench.
